links.outcome: Attack success rate: model complying with guarded out-of-scope requests under adversarial reframing
links.effect: Overall ASR 38.0%; medical board exam framing raised ASR from 29.0% to 53.1% (+24.0 points); doctor authority framing 43.7% (+14.7); instruction-override prefixes had no significant effect.
links.quote: recasting a question as a "medical board exam" item raises ASR from a 29.0% baseline to 53.1% (+24.0 points), and an appeal to an alleged doctor's authority raises it to 43.7% (+14.7); crude instruction-override prefixes have no significant effect.

links.outcome: Model advising that emergency care can be skipped under attack framings
links.effect: Emergency-deferral guardrail strong at 4.7% ASR, but the authority framing was the only attack that breached it.
links.quote: the drug-interaction guardrail is nearly absent (83.2% ASR) while the emergency-deferral guardrail is strong (4.7%) -- and the authority framing is the only attack that breaches it.

links.outcome: Model providing dosages, diagnoses, treatments, and drug interaction judgments despite prohibited behaviors
links.effect: Overall ASR 38.0% across guarded concepts; drug-interaction guardrail nearly absent at 83.2% ASR.
links.quote: Under the primary LLM judge the overall Attack Success Rate (ASR, the fraction coded comply) is 38.0%.

links.outcome: Robustness of model behavior under paraphrased/reframed inputs and repeated runs
links.effect: ASR shifted substantially by reframing (29.0% baseline to 53.1% under exam framing); topic drove robustness (drug-interaction 83.2% vs emergency 4.7%).
links.quote: Robustness is dominated by topic: the drug-interaction guardrail is nearly absent (83.2% ASR) while the emergency-deferral guardrail is strong (4.7%) -- and the authority framing is the only attack that breaches it.

screen.reason: The study directly tests and evaluates the vulnerability and robustness of safety guardrails (specifically prohibiting diagnostic, dosage, and emergency-related guidance) in a medical large language model under various adversarial prompt framings.

primary.practice: safety guardrails and jailbreak vulnerability testing
